pronunciation.approximation: Say "perun" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Perun".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "perun" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Perun" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Perun
domains.subtitle: Thunder
domains.lead: Perun is thunder, lightning, oak. The name means "Thunderer, striker" and belongs to the slavic tradition.

cards.name: Sacred Name
cards.desc: The restoration Perun returns the figure to scholarly recognition.

cards.name: Living Tradition
cards.desc: Honored in slavic myth, cult, and cultural memory.

symbols.name: Name
symbols.meaning: The restored form Perun, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.

mythology.lead: The stories of Perun place thunder, lightning, oak at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Perun appears in slavic tradition as thunder, lightning, oak. The name's meaning, "Thunderer, striker", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Perun in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Perun remains a touchstone for understanding slavic religion, art, and identity.
